text: Keelan Giles and Dan Edwards on the way to Japan with Wales

During the Six Nations, Edwards, who is 22, played as a substitute in two matches against France and Italy while under the guidance of former head coach Warren Gatland, with Cardiff centre Ben Thomas taking on the role of fly-half in both Paris and Rome.
Japan's only victory in 14 games against Wales came in 2013 when the 23-8 victory was masterminded by Jones during his first spell in charge.

Inspired by their 36-year-old captain Michael Leitch, Japan secured victory thanks to tries scored by Takuro Matsunga, Ichigo Nakakusu, and Vailea, along with nine points contributed by Seungsin Lee's kicking.
It was a second victory for Japan against Wales, with Jones also masterminding the first in 2013.
